description: The Lectric XPress2 is designed to make every ride feel effortless, whether you’re commuting across town, cruising the neighborhood, or simply enjoying the ride. Building on the success of the original XPress, the XPress2 introduces more power, smoother performance, and two ride styles tailored to different riders: the sporty commuter and the laid-back comfort cruiser. Powered by a high-output, whisper-quiet 750W motor and customizable pedal assist, the XPress2 delivers a smoother ride. This eBike introduces category-leading upgrades like an adjustable SR SunTour suspension fork, StarUnion 602 hydraulic disc brakes, a Shimano Altus 8-speed drivetrain, and a large TFT color display. With fast charging capabilities, up to 60 miles of range, and refined comfort-focused geometry, the XPress2 brings a more elevated riding experience to everyday adventures.

components.description: The front wheel features a specially designed, ultra-fast thru-axle attachment system for quick, tool-free installation. This design helps ensure precise wheel alignment, consistent brake rotor positioning, and stable handling. Remove the wheel in minutes for easier, more lightweight transport.

Get ultimate stopping power with 602 hydraulic brakes paired with 180mm rotors (2.3mm thick), making it as easy to stop as it is to go, whether in wet or dry conditions. Paired with ergonomically designed aluminum brake levers for durability.
A KMC Z8 steel chain with inner plate chamfering offers consistent tension and smooth transitions between shifting for a secure performance throughout your ride.
11-32 tooth, 8-speed freewheel
Forged aluminum, 46-tooth custom chainring is the perfect ratio for effortless 27.5-inch wheel pedaling.
Shimano Altus derailleur

A removable 48V, 14Ah (672Wh) lithium-ion battery certified to UL 2271, integrated on the down tube of the frame, makes for a clean and easily-accessible design while powering your ride for up to 60 miles on a single charge.*** The XPress2 is also certified to UL 2849.†

An external charging port provides riders with the option to charge the eBike without removing the battery. The XPress2 comes standard with a 2amp charger for 5-7 hour charging, but a 5amp Fast Charger can be purchased separately, which can charge the long-range battery in less than 3 hours.

A custom color TFT display featuring a detachable mount and a USB-C port provides trip, battery, & power intelligence on the go. New intuitive drop-down menus make navigating the settings on your eBike easy to understand & allow users to customize their ride settings based on preference. The IP-X5-rated display ensures greater water resistance.
A 750W rear hub motor (1310W peak) with 85Nm of torque supplies power and speed quicker than ever before. Stealth M24 technology delivers a quieter motor experience without sacrificing power.
The XPress2 features a best-in-class SR SunTour XCM 32 suspension fork with up to 80mm of travel, providing shock absorption for a smooth ride.
Full-length ergonomic lock-on grips add comfort so you can ride longer. The plastic sleeve inside helps lock the grips into place and also allows the grips to be easily removed.

The XPress2 High-Step Commuter features sporty Hybrid Sprint™ handlebars with a fixed stem, creating a more athletic, active riding position for confident handling and responsive control. Designed for riders who prefer a performance-inspired feel, the setup delivers a sleek, streamlined look while maintaining the durability and low-maintenance simplicity of a classic commuter bike.
A heavy-duty steel side-sweeping kickstand located near the chainstay keeps the eBike upright.

An integrated safety system, featuring a new bright 90-lumen headlamp with side amber lights and a brake-activated rear light powered by the internal battery, allows you to be seen at any time of day.
Alert drivers, riders, and people nearby with our turn signals. Simply use the left or right arrows on the button pad to turn on the blinkers on either side of the rear light.

components.type_detail: Pick your Pedal Response; XPerience Switch™
components.description: Choose between responsive pedaling vs. standard pedaling with an easy adjustment to the settings, switching between a torque and cadence sensor. The torque sensor offers a more natural, smooth feel with intuitive power that responds to your pedal pressure. The cadence sensor provides power with each revolution of the pedals, making it a great option for beginners or anyone looking for a more relaxed ride.

Custom-designed 6000 Series Aluminum quick-release pedals with splined inserts allow for easy, tool-free removal and installation. The new shape of the pedals improves foot traction for an optimal experience.
A custom-designed saddle complements a sporty look while adding comfort so you can ride longer.
Customize the bike to your perfect size by adjusting the seat post height; simply open the quick-release collar and slide the post to your preferred height and lock it in place by closing the collar.

Our proprietary in-house-designed torque sensor programming will give you smoother power distribution and a better riding experience. It is designed to manage power output based on the rider’s pedaling effort. With this programming experience, riders can reach higher speeds easily and with more control than ever before.
below-the-bar trigger shifter
An ergonomic below-the-bar trigger throttle on the left-hand side is easily engaged with your thumb while simultaneously eliminating joint fatigue.

Puncture-resistant 27.5” x 2.1” slick tires can handle any commute with ease. The sidewall features reflective strips for better visibility at night. Slime is installed to prevent flat tires—at no additional cost.
24amp internal controller is IP-X5 rated and potted for weatherproofing and thermal management.
